seeker.note: SIM_TUNED: radome / thin RF-transparent nose; lowest resistance.

guidance.note: SIM_TUNED: electronics in thin light-alloy housing; low resistance.

fuze.note: SIM_TUNED: sensitive initiation electronics immediately ahead of warhead.

warhead.note: SIM_TUNED: thick steel warhead case; highest compartment resistance.

fuel.note: SIM_TUNED: thin skin but liquid/propellant contents absorb fragment work.

engine.note: SIM_TUNED: turbine/rocket motor casing and dense machinery; high resistance.

fins.note: SIM_TUNED: thin exposed rear control surfaces; very low resistance.

fragmentBreakupModel.note: Terminal pieces from one titanium rod are spatially correlated; coverage count is intentionally lower than terminal piece count.

ESSM_BLK2_ADAPTIVE_LAUNCH_LOFT.name: ESSM Block 2 Adaptive Direct / Mild Loft
ESSM_BLK2_ADAPTIVE_LAUNCH_LOFT.note: SIM_TUNED: very urgent sea-skimmer/diver shots finish body alignment near 8 m; ordinary threats ~15-25 m; long shots transition gently at 28 m+ with only mild energy loft.

SM6_BLKIA_ADAPTIVE_ENERGY_LOFT.name: SM-6 Block IA Adaptive Direct / Networked Energy Loft
SM6_BLKIA_ADAPTIVE_ENERGY_LOFT.note: SIM_TUNED schedule. Network/ARH affects sensor authority, never free kinematics; no hard range/altitude/speed is encoded.

SM2ER_BLKIV_ADAPTIVE_ENERGY_LOFT.name: SM-2ER Block IV Adaptive Direct / Energy Loft
SM2ER_BLKIV_ADAPTIVE_ENERGY_LOFT.note: SIM_TUNED guidance schedule. Turn request begins at the same 50/65/85 m safety floor as SM-2MR; actual shorter turnover must emerge from Mk 72 TVC, mass and force/moment integration.

SM2MR_ADAPTIVE_ENERGY_LOFT.name: SM-2MR Adaptive Direct / Energy Loft
SM2MR_ADAPTIVE_ENERGY_LOFT.note: SIM_TUNED: urgent threats use the minimum ~50 m turn start and direct intercept; range/TGO progressively shift the missile toward a stronger energy loft, with long shots climbing high before terminal convergence.

SM2MR_BLKIIIA_SIM.notes: SM-2MR Block IIIA dedicated working component set: Mk104 propulsion + Mk45 Mod9 TDD working variant binding + Mk125 Mod0 controlled-fragmentation warhead. SARH-dependent terminal; no Mk72 booster separation. WIP14A7 removes the former half-Cd calibration and every gameplay speed cap.

SM2ER_BLKIV_SIM.notes: Live WIP14A5 two-stage round. 50 m urgent turn request matches SM-2MR; achieved close-in turnover is a physical Mk72 TVC/force/moment result. No normal gameplay speed cap.

SM6_BLKIA_SIM.notes: Live WIP14A6 manual air-defense round. Active AMRAAM-derived terminal seeker with real measurement-native SARH fallback. ESSM-derived ECCM is a simulation-family abstraction, not a literal hardware derivation. No normal gameplay speed cap.

ESSM_BLK2_SIM.notes: WIP139 canonical candidate: Mk 134 Mod 0; 280 kg launch, 167.8 kg motor gross, 119.3 kg propellant, 48.5 kg motor inert, ~8 s observed burn; DERIVED_CONSTRAINED grain rRod≈18.1 mm / rAnnulusInner≈36.1 mm / rod burnout≈1.75 s. USER-SELECTED MODELED candidates: whole-motor Isp=258 s and JVC jettison mass=12.68 kg. WIP139 SIM-VALIDATED physical 6DOF limits: 48G optimal / 60G structural. Legacy v1 guidance altitude-proxy command cap remains 44→34G pending separate audit.

SM2MR_BLKIIIA_6DOF_LITE.label: SM-2MR IIIA BODY-6DOF-LITE
SM2MR_BLKIIIA_6DOF_LITE.note: SIM_TUNED tail-control 6DOF-lite. Actual body rate/G emerge from q, fin actuator state, force/moment and inertia; no TVC.

SM6_BLKIA_6DOF_LITE.label: SM-6 Block IA TWO-STAGE BODY-6DOF-LITE+MK72-TVC
SM6_BLKIA_6DOF_LITE.note: Same external Standard-Missile airframe control model as ER; extra SM-6 guidance-section dry mass changes inertia/TW. Mk72 TVC ends at booster separation.

SM2ER_BLKIV_6DOF_LITE.label: SM-2ER Block IV TWO-STAGE BODY-6DOF-LITE+MK72-TVC
SM2ER_BLKIV_6DOF_LITE.note: Mk 72 TVC remains physical thrust side-force and moment only through booster separation. Exact production TVC/aero coefficients are public unknown.

ESSM_BLK2_6DOF_LITE.label: ESSM Block 2 BODY-6DOF-LITE+TVC
ESSM_BLK2_6DOF_LITE.note: SIM_TUNED agile 6DOF-lite. JVC dominates VLS/pitch-over and is jettisoned on PITCHOVER_COMPLETE; aerodynamic fins take over as q rises. WIP139 physical load limits are 48G optimal / 60G structural.
